scope: Clear materially incomplete or incorrect READY_FOR_DRY_RUN cases only; a lower bound, not an exhaustive safety audit

cases.failure: Morning travel constraint omitted from the draft; Planner marked the train search ready with date and stops but no daypart.
The user requested an albergo in central Trieste; the draft retained Trieste but lost the central-area constraint and was marked ready.
The user requested regional trains; the draft omitted the regional category and was marked ready.
The bathroom was grounded as the provider search location, although the user gave no geographic location. The draft and Planner marked the provider search ready.
The user requested a room for Sunday; the draft omitted the day and was marked ready.
A hotel and a train were requested. The runtime finalized and passed only the hotel to the Planner while the train draft remained active, exposing a partial request as ready.

other_clear_failures_without_ready.failure: A chat utterance about finishing a book opened a find-book draft, but the capability lookup blocked it.
Arrival deadline continuation opened an unrelated reminder draft rather than updating the active train search.
The reply 'the second' was interpreted as a new goal. No result list was supplied in the benchmark, so actual reference resolution cannot be certified.
